patterns.repair: Add valid frontmatter fields; preserve the original source.

patterns.diagnosis: A declared dependency cannot be resolved.
patterns.repair: Verify the dependency name and add or correct the target; do not infer aliases.
Break the smallest unnecessary edge and add a regression test.

patterns.diagnosis: A platform-specific capability leaks into the target profile.
patterns.repair: Move platform calls behind an adapter and provide a portable fallback.

patterns.diagnosis: Provenance is incomplete, so drift cannot be verified.
patterns.repair: Read back canonical source and export before pinning normalized SHA-256 hashes.

patterns.diagnosis: A snapshot differs from its pinned digest.
patterns.repair: Inspect the diff; never overwrite canonical source or export automatically.
